grammar.explanation: Was = là/có (số ít: I/he/she/it). Were = là/có (số nhiều: you/we/they). Phủ định: wasn't / weren't. Câu hỏi: Was...? / Were...? Dùng để nói về quá khứ.
grammar.explanationVi: Was = là/có (số ít: I/he/she/it). Were = là/có (số nhiều: you/we/they). Phủ định: wasn't / weren't. Câu hỏi: Was...? / Were...? Dùng để nói về quá khứ.
lines: I was in Da Nang last week.
They were tired after the trip.
Was the hotel good? — Yes, it was.
Were you at home? — No, I wasn't.
commonMistakes: Sai: 'I were in Da Nang.' → Đúng: 'I was in Da Nang.'
Sai: 'They was tired.' → Đúng: 'They were tired.'
Sai: 'I was not at home.' (đúng) vs 'I wasn't at home.' (cũng đúng)

grammar.section: GRAMMAR IN USE · PAST SIMPLE (REGULAR VERBS)
grammar.explanation: Quá khứ đơn với động từ có quy tắc: thêm 'ed' vào động từ (visit → visited, stay → stayed). Phủ định: didn't + nguyên mẫu. Câu hỏi: Did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu?
grammar.explanationVi: Quá khứ đơn với động từ có quy tắc: thêm 'ed' vào động từ (visit → visited, stay → stayed). Phủ định: didn't + nguyên mẫu. Câu hỏi: Did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu?
lines: I didn't go to the party.
commonMistakes: Sai: 'I visit my friend yesterday.' → Đúng: 'I visited my friend yesterday.'
Sai: 'She didn't stayed.' → Đúng: 'She didn't stay.'
Sai: 'Did you went?' → Đúng: 'Did you go?'

dialogue.line: Did you go on holiday this year?
Yes, I went to Da Nang.
It was great. The weather was sunny and warm.
We stayed at a hotel near the beach.
Did you go to the beach every day?
Yes, we did. We swam and walked on the sand.
Yes, I bought a small painting for my mom.
That sounds wonderful. I want to go there too.
You should! It's a beautiful city.

reading.title: My Trip to Hoi An
reading.titleVi: Chuyến đi Hội An của tôi
reading.text: Last summer, I went to Hoi An with my family. We traveled by car. The trip took three hours. We stayed at a small hotel in the old town. The hotel was clean and comfortable. On the first day, we walked around the old town. We saw many old houses and bridges. On the second day, we went to the beach. The beach was beautiful. We swam and played in the sand. In the evening, we ate delicious food at a local restaurant. I bought a lantern as a souvenir. I really enjoyed the trip. I want to go back next year.

review.summary: In this unit, you learned to talk about travel and holidays using past simple. Key phrases: 'Did you go on holiday?', 'Where did you go?', 'How was it?', 'Where did you stay?', 'It was great/wonderful.'
review.summaryVi: Trong unit này, bạn đã học cách nói về du lịch và kỳ nghỉ dùng thì quá khứ đơn. Cụm từ quan trọng: 'Did you go on holiday?', 'Where did you go?', 'How was it?', 'Where did you stay?', 'It was great/wonderful.'
